title: Keeping the Young Tuxedo Orchestra after John's death
summary: He intends to keep the Young Tuxedo name, handles the orchestra, and turns the brass band side over to Morgan since his illness.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Ernie Cagnoletti, yeah. Yeah, Cagnoletti. On trumpet. Uh-huh. Yeah. Are you going to continue on with this Young Tuxedo Orchestra? You going to use that name?
Mm-hmm. I'm going to try to hold it as long as I can, Dick. Mm-hmm. I'm going to change it. I don't have no reason for changing it.
See, I was playing with him when John died.
And I'd take it over, but unfortunately I'd take the sick.
I couldn't run the brass band, so I just told Morgan, I'd turn the brass band part over to him. And any job come through for the brass band, come to me, I'd contact him.
But the orchestra part, I'm going to handle that. Mm-hmm. I see.
